text: Enterprise Holdings was created in 2009 as a holding company for the Taylor family's growing portfolio of car rental and transportation services; the Enterprise, National and Alamo brands all fall under this company.
short: Enterprise Rent-A-Car sits under Enterprise Holdings, the Taylor family holding company

source.name: Enterprise Mobility: Our Heritage (company history page)
source.quote: Enterprise Holdings is created as a holding company for the Taylor family’s growing portfolio of car rental and transportation services. Enterprise, National and Alamo all fall under this company.
